notes.title: Update v1.0.2 Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Update v1.0.2 Now Live![/h1]

[b]Hello, fellow gamers![/b]

We're thrilled to announce that [b]Update v1.2.0[/b] is now live and packed with exciting new features, gameplay improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Dive into the details below and see what's new!

[hr][/hr]

[h1] New Features[/h1]

[h2]Blast Cap Target Selection[/h2]

[b]Player-Controlled Targeting[/b]: After placing a Blast Cap, you can now select an enemy cell to attack. This adds a new layer of strategy, allowing you to make tactical decisions to outsmart your opponents.

[b]AI Integration[/b]: The AI will intelligently select targets when using the Blast Cap, ensuring challenging and dynamic gameplay even in single-player modes.

[h2]Blue Shell Rule Implementation[/h2]

[b]Comeback Mechanics[/b]: Players who are behind in cell count now have increased chances of receiving [i]power mushrooms[/i] (rare mushrooms with special abilities).

[b]Balanced Probability[/b]: Only mushrooms with a rarity value ([i]PerThousand[/i]) less than [b]500[/b] are considered power mushrooms. The probability of obtaining these is increased for trailing players, helping to level the playing field.

[hr][/hr]

[h1] Gameplay Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Mushroom Growth Patterns Adjusted[/h2]

[b]Controlled Expansion[/b]: Certain mushrooms will no longer grow into visible cells. This prevents unexpected behaviors.

[b]Affected Mushrooms[/b]: [list] [*]Death Cap [*]Ghost NPC [*]Triple Cap [*]Double Blue [*]Double Cap [*]Green Button [*]Blaze Button [*]Lamp Shade [*]Midnight [*]Morel Cap [*]Night Cap [*]Tree Top [*]Brown Cap [*]Boom Cap [/list]

[h2]Improved AI Decision-Making[/h2]

[b]Smarter Opponents[/b]: The AI now better evaluates where to place mushrooms based on their types and strategic value.

[b]Enhanced Tactics[/b]: AI players consider whether mushrooms perform best near their own territory or near enemies, making single-player matches more engaging.

[hr][/hr]

[h1] Bug Fixes[/h1]

[b]Fixed Blast Cap Crash[/b]: Resolved an issue where the game could crash when the AI placed a Blast Cap. The Blast Cap now functions correctly for both players and AI.

[b]Turn Progression Issue[/b]: Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't proceed to the AI's turn after a player placed a Blast Cap. The game now smoothly transitions between turns.

[b]NullReferenceException Fix[/b]: Addressed a rare error that could occur during AI mushroom placement, improving overall game stability.

[hr][/hr]

[h1] Balance Changes[/h1]

[h2]Adjusted Mushroom Probabilities[/h2]

[b]Fair Play[/b]: Reworked the probability distribution for mushroom types to balance gameplay, especially in competitive matches.

[b]Power Mushroom Distribution[/b]: Trailing players have a higher chance of receiving power mushrooms, making comebacks more achievable and matches more exciting.

[hr][/hr]

[h1] User Interface Enhancements[/h1]

[b]Enhanced Notifications[/b]: Added new in-game messages to guide you when selecting targets for the Blast Cap or when an action isn't possible.

[b]Improved Tooltips[/b]: Mushroom tooltips now display more detailed information, helping you make informed decisions during gameplay.


[hr][/hr]

[h1] Miscellaneous[/h1]

[b]Code Optimization[/b]: Refactored parts of the game code for better performance and smoother gameplay.

[b]Stability Improvements[/b]: Fixed minor bugs and optimized game systems to enhance stability.

[hr][/hr]

[h1] Thank You for Your Support![/h1]

We want to extend a huge [b]thank you[/b] to all our players for your continued support and feedback. Your insights are invaluable and help us make the game better with each update.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Happy gaming and see you on the battlefield![/b]

[i]— Crimson Leaf Team[/i]



[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Mushroom Moonrise - Update 0.4 Were almost ready!
notes.content:
[h1]Mushroom Moonrise - Update 0.4: New Mushrooms, Bug Fixes, and More![/h1]

[b]Greetings, fellow mushroom enthusiasts![/b]

We’re excited to announce a brand-new update for [i]Mushroom Moonrise[/i]! This patch brings fresh content, essential bug fixes, and gameplay enhancements to enrich your fungal adventures. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re thrilled to share these latest additions.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🆕 New Mushroom Types[/h2]

[b]🌟 BlastCap Mushroom[/b]
[i]Description:[/i] Meet the BlastCap! This explosive, rocket-shaped mushroom adds a new level of excitement.
[i]Behavior:[/i]
[list] [][b]Targeting:[/b] Upon planting, the BlastCap locks onto an enemy cell. [][b]Growth:[/b] It matures normally, then launches toward its target during the spore phase. [][b]Explosion:[/b] Detonates upon arrival, clearing the target cell and surrounding areas. [][b]Poison Effect:[/b] May poison cells for several growth cycles, causing a lasting impact. [*][b]Strategic Use:[/b] Use the BlastCap to disrupt enemy territory in both single-player and versus modes. [/list]

[b]👻 GhostNPC Mushroom[/b]
[i]Description:[/i] Beware of the GhostNPC, a spectral mushroom that haunts the grid.
[i]Behavior:[/i]
[list] []Moves to adjacent cells each growth cycle, poisoning other mushrooms it encounters. [][b]Strategic Use:[/b] Deploy GhostNPCs to sabotage enemy expansions and control key areas. [/list]

[b]💡 Lampshade Mushroom[/b]
[i]Description:[/i] Illuminate your strategy with the Lampshade mushroom.
[i]Behavior:[/i]
[list] []Interacts with neighboring mushrooms, capable of poisoning GhostNPCs or accelerating friendly mushrooms’ growth. [][b]Strategic Use:[/b] Use the Lampshade to support your mushrooms and weaken nearby enemies. [/list]

[b]🍄 Green Button Mushroom[/b]
[i]Description:[/i] The Green Button is a straightforward mushroom, focused on movement.
[i]Behavior:[/i]
[list] []Moves to a random neighboring cell during growth, updating ownership and visuals upon arrival. [][b]Strategic Use:[/b] Efficiently expand territory by spreading Green Buttons across the grid. [/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🛠️ New Features and Improvements[/h2]

[b]🚀 Animated BlastCap Rocket[/b]
[list] [*]The BlastCap now features an animated rocket that launches toward target cells with enhanced explosion effects. [/list]

[b]🌈 Rainbow Road Level Selection[/b]
[list] [*]A new level selection screen with levels unlocking progressively based on your progress, providing more control and clarity. [/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b]🔧 GhostNPC NullReferenceException Resolved:[/b] Fixed an error where GhostNPCs caused unintended cell resets.
[b]🔧 Lampshade Stability:[/b] Addressed a growth cycle issue with proper null checks, ensuring smooth interactions.
[b]🔧 Green Button Ownership Correction:[/b] Updated movement logic for accurate ownership and color feedback.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]⚙️ Gameplay Adjustments[/h2]

[b]🎯 BlastCap Targeting Logic Enhanced:[/b] BlastCaps now identify enemy cells more accurately, adapting to both single-player and versus modes.
[b]🌀 Dynamic Targeting for BlastCap:[/b] If no target is found initially, the BlastCap will reattempt targeting each growth cycle, increasing its reliability.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]📢 Community Spotlight[/h2]

A big thank you to everyone who provided feedback and suggestions! Your input helps us improve [i]Mushroom Moonrise[/i] with each update.

[hr][/hr]

[b]🚀 Update Now![/b]
Fire up [i]Mushroom Moonrise[/i] to experience the latest features and improvements. As always, join the discussion on our Steam Community Hub—we’d love to hear from you!

Thank you for your continued support, and happy mushrooming!
